about.title: Established care, now serving Madhanandapuram
body: Dr Gupta's Hospital (Main Branch) was built on a simple idea — a neighborhood hospital shouldn't feel like a maze. Patients should be able to walk in, be seen quickly, and trust the people treating them.

As our main branch, we bring together general medicine, surgery, pediatrics, and obstetric care under one roof, backed by an in-house pharmacy, diagnostic support, and a team that knows most of its patients by name.
highlights: Multi-speciality care across general medicine, surgery, pediatrics and obstetrics
Experienced team led by our founding doctor

blogPosts.title: When to Visit a Hospital vs. a Local Clinic
blogPosts.excerpt: Not sure whether your symptoms need a quick clinic visit or a hospital? Here's a simple way to decide.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Rajesh Gupta
content: A lot of patients hesitate before deciding where to go — a nearby clinic, or a hospital like ours. The honest answer is that it depends on how urgent and how uncertain the situation is.
For routine issues — a common cold, minor cuts, a repeat prescription — a local clinic is often faster and perfectly adequate.

But if there's any chance you might need diagnostics, observation, or admission — persistent high fever, breathing difficulty, severe pain, an injury that won't stop bleeding, or symptoms that keep getting worse — go straight to a hospital with round-the-clock care and on-site diagnostic support.
When in doubt, it's always safer to come in and be checked. Our general and emergency team is available every day, all day, specifically for these judgment calls — you don't have to make them alone.
